interest: Shows 1930s Japanese exposition diplomacy, State's policy of declining official funding while aiding publicity, and the war-postponed 1940 Tokyo fair.
overview: This file consists of Department of State docket sheets (Lists of Papers and jacket case sheets) for decimal file 894.607 ('Industrial Matters. Japan: Expositions. Exhibitions. Included All Expositions Of Whatever Character'), documenting U.S. diplomatic correspondence, interdepartmental circulars, and foreign intelligence concerning international expositions held or planned in Japan between 1931 and 1940. Major events cataloged across the sub-jackets include the 1931 Siamese Exposition and the 1933 Women's and Children's International Exhibition in Ueno Park, Tokyo; the 1935 Yokohama Municipal Exposition; the 1935 Osaka Commercial Museum exhibit; the 1937 Nagoya Pan Pacific Peace Exhibition; and the planned 1940 International Exposition of Japan in Tokyo commemorating the 2600th anniversary of the founding of the Japanese Empire. The docket entries reflect standard U.S. foreign policy declining official government participation and appropriations—frequently on the grounds that invitations were initiated by local promoters rather than the Japanese Imperial Government—while arranging for domestic executive departments to circulate publicity to private commercial exhibitors, as well as tracking Japanese promotional missions throughout Latin America until the 1940 Tokyo exposition was postponed.

subfiles.about: Master docket sheet and cross-reference list indexing communications and sub-jackets relating to exhibitions and expositions held in Japan between 1931 and 1940.
subfiles.summary: Master docket cross-references seven 1931-38 exposition records: Siamese, Women's & Children's, Yokohama, Osaka, Nagoya, New York, and Tokyo 1940.
subfiles.title: List of Papers: Expositions — Japan (Decimal File 894.607)

subfiles.about: Four-page jacket case docket record tracking correspondence, interdepartmental circulars, and diplomatic reports regarding the 1937 Nagoya Pan Pacific Peace Exhibition.
subfiles.summary: List details 49 records on the 1937 Nagoya Pan Pacific Peace Exhibition: State declined official participation but coordinated agency publicity, noting Prince Higashikuni's governorship, Latin American and Philippine missions, the opening, and 'America Day.'
subfiles.title: List of Papers: Nagoya Pan Pacific Peace Exhibition (Decimal File 894.607 Nagoya)

subfiles.about: Docket sheet recording a diplomatic dispatch regarding Dominican Republic participation in the 1935 Osaka Commercial Museum exhibition.
subfiles.summary: Records a 1934 despatch noting Santo Domingo's invitation to the Osaka Commercial Museum exhibit, with goods shipped to Japan.
subfiles.title: List of Papers: Osaka Commercial Museum (Decimal File 894.607 Osaka)

subfiles.about: Two-page docket record tracking diplomatic negotiations, policy discussions, and overseas promotional missions relating to the planned 1940 Tokyo International Exposition.
subfiles.summary: Catalogs 20 entries on the planned 1940 Tokyo Exposition marking Emperor Jimmu's 2600th anniversary: Grew declined honorary counselor duty, Philippine participation was discussed, and diplomatic posts reported Japanese solicitation before its 1938 indefinite postponement.
subfiles.title: List of Papers: International Exposition of Japan, Tokyo, 1940 (Decimal File 894.607 Tokyo)

subfiles.about: Two-page docket record documenting U.S. government responses and publicity efforts regarding the 1933 Women's and Children's International Exhibition in Tokyo.
subfiles.summary: Lists 17 1932-33 records on Tokyo's Women's and Children's International Exhibition: Grew transmits Japan's invitation, Labor, Interior, and the Red Cross decline official participation for lack of funds, duty-free entry is assured, and officers attend 'American Day.'
subfiles.title: List of Papers: Women's & Children's International Exhibition, Tokyo, 1933 (Decimal File 894.607 Women's)

subfiles.about: Preliminary typed docket list recording initial correspondence and departmental referrals regarding the 1935 Yokohama Municipal Exposition.
subfiles.summary: Draft docket on the 1935 Yokohama Exposition: Boyce corresponds with the Mayor; Commerce and Interior decline exhibits but promise publicity.
subfiles.title: Draft List of Papers: Yokohama Municipal Exposition (Decimal File 894.607 Yokohama)

subfiles.about: Formal jacket case docket sheet recording correspondence and interdepartmental actions regarding the 1935 Yokohama Municipal Exposition.
subfiles.summary: Records eleven 1934 items on the Yokohama Exposition: Boyce's reports, a Japanese invitation, and agencies declining exhibits but promising publicity.
subfiles.title: List of Papers: Yokohama Municipal Exposition (Decimal File 894.607 Yokohama)
